note: Three text briefs. 'fixed' quantities must appear in the design object with these exact keys and values (1 % relative tolerance); 'free' quantities the arm chooses. Key names are the ones lean_check itself reports as `missing`, read off a probe call before this file was written. Lawset is pinned to 1.8.1. No bird taxon.

tasks.brief: Specify a gliding adult flying fish (family Exocoetidae) for the studio. The sponsor fixes the animal's size and air: standard length 0.25 m, mass 0.075 kg, air density 1.225 kg/m3, launch height 1.0 m above the water. It is an UNPOWERED glide, not powered flight. You choose the pectoral lifting area, the maximum lift coefficient, the glide lift-to-drag ratio, the airspeed and the resulting glide distance so that the specification is internally consistent and no accepted Lean-backed law at lawset 1.8.1 is violated. Depth and altitude are both 0 m.

Specify an adult zebrafish (Danio rerio) for the studio as a purely aquatic, non-flying design. The sponsor fixes: standard length 0.035 m, mass 0.0008 kg, body temperature 26 C, thermal lower limit 6.2 C, thermal upper limit 41.4 C, Q10 of 2.3 referenced to 28 C, holding depth 0.3 m, altitude 0 m. There is no flight: say so explicitly in the design rather than leaving the flight fields blank. You choose the critical swimming speed and the current speed the animal must hold against, and any further quantity you need, so that no accepted Lean-backed law at lawset 1.8.1 is violated.

Specify an adult flying fish (family Exocoetidae) whose glide must be POWERED by its own aerobic capacity for a 3.0 s burst, so the aerobic-demand laws are in scope rather than out of it. The sponsor fixes: standard length 0.25 m, mass 0.075 kg, air density 1.225 kg/m3, flight duration 3.0 s, launch height 1.0 m, depth 0 m, altitude 0 m. You choose the lifting area, lift coefficient, lift-to-drag ratio, airspeed, the power available, the sustained power the flight demands, and the aerobic-chain quantities (efficiency, oxycaloric equivalent, cardiac output, arterial oxygen content) needed to make the aerobic laws evaluable. Make the specification internally consistent and violate no accepted Lean-backed law at lawset 1.8.1 -- or, if the brief cannot be met, say which law blocks it and give the design that comes closest.
